purpose: Bounded primary-source differential diagnosis; none is established as KAN7's cause or duplicate.

candidates.reportedSignature: KWin6.7.3+ wl_fixes v2 client disconnect; registry/global protocol error while making surfaces visible
candidates.scopeDifference: Debian reported6.7.4-1 and fixed6.7.4-2; KAN7 Fedora KDE6.7.5 package/backports unknown, silent process survival rather than logged disconnect
candidates.assessment: Conditional compositor hypothesis only; require matching protocol error/backport evidence, not version substring.

candidates.reportedSignature: Linux wrong-monitor placement regression; official158.0.1 release notes mention placement fix
candidates.scopeDifference: A mapped misplaced window is distinct from a proven startup wait; KAN7 has no surface/mapping trace
candidates.assessment: Check actual mapping/monitor coordinates before classifying no visible window as deadlock; not a known KAN7 fix.

candidates.reportedSignature: Intel Meteor Lake graphics hangs in two benchmark workloads on26.2.0–26.2.4
candidates.scopeDifference: KAN7 Intel TGL GT1, different GPU/workload
candidates.assessment: Insufficient match; do not attribute KAN7 to this Mesa fix or require a driver upgrade as a diagnosis.

candidates.reportedSignature: NVIDIA dmabuf import protocol crash with Vulkan video decoding and HDR
candidates.scopeDifference: KAN7 startup/no window, Intel active in XWayland, no video/HDR evidence, NVIDIA driver unknown
candidates.assessment: Insufficient match; not the original silent hang and not a confirmed external dependency.
